Messages.Author: Dave Tait
Messages.Body:
If a vampire with superior celerity and a sniper rifle blocks an
action, both combatants are ready when combat ends, and psyche at
superior is played, does sniper rifles range setting ability still
function in the new combat, or is it no longer a combat resulting from
a successful block?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The latter.
